VarCategory.title: VarCategory
VarCategory.description: Identify the category: 'Demande information', 'Echange produit', 'Réclamation', or 'Retour produit'. If damaged, use 'Réclamation'.

VarContactId.title: VarContactId
VarContactId.description: Internal ID. Do not ask the user for this value.

VarDescription.title: VarDescription
VarDescription.description: A detailed explanation of the issue the customer is facing with their handbag.

VarPriority.title: VarPriority
VarPriority.description: Assess urgency: 'High' for severe damage or deadlines, otherwise 'Medium'. Do not ask the user.

VarSubcategory.title: VarSubcategory
VarSubcategory.description:
Based on the selected VarCategory, pick the exact subcategory value.

Si la catégorie est 'Echange produit', la sous-catégorie doit impérativement être l'une de ces valeurs : 'Taille / ajustement', 'Couleur / modèle', 'Produit défectueux' ou 'Produit non conforme à la commande'.

VarSubject.title: VarSubject
VarSubject.description: Generate a short, professional subject line based on the description. Do not ask the user.

Var_OrderNumber.title: Var_OrderNumber
Var_OrderNumber.description: Ask the user for their order number. It is required to link the case to their purchase history.

Var_PurchaseDate.title: Var_PurchaseDate
Var_PurchaseDate.description: Ask for the purchase date. If the user says 'yesterday' or 'last Monday', convert it to YYYY/MM/DD.

Var_email.title: Var_email
Var_email.description: Ask the user for their email address. This is required to identify the customer in the system before creating the support case.

contactRecord.title: contactRecord
contactRecord.description: Technical variable for flow processing. Internal use only. Do not ask the user for this value.
